+    n = len(sizes)

+    # Sort items decreasingly by size.
+    order = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: sizes[i], reverse=True)
+
+    bins = []          # list of lists of item indices
+    loads = []         # current load per bin
+    rem = []           # remaining capacity per bin
+
+    # Constructive phase: best-fit (smallest remaining space that fits).
+    for idx in order:
+        s = sizes[idx]
+        best_b = -1
+        best_rem = capacity + 1
+        for b in range(len(bins)):
+            r = rem[b]
+            if s <= r and r < best_rem:
+                best_rem = r
+                best_b = b
+        if best_b >= 0:
+            bins[best_b].append(idx)
+            loads[best_b] += s
+            rem[best_b] -= s
+        else:
+            bins.append([idx])
+            loads.append(s)
+            rem.append(capacity - s)
+
+    # Local search: repeatedly try to eliminate the least-filled bin.
+    deadline = time.process_time() + 1.9
+    improved = True
+    while improved and time.process_time() < deadline:
+        improved = False
+        # Find least-filled non-empty bin.
+        worst = min(range(len(bins)), key=lambda b: loads[b])
+        items = list(bins[worst])
+        removed = False
+
+        # Try moving items one by one to other bins (direct fit).
+        for idx in items:
+            if time.process_time() >= deadline:
+                break
+            s = sizes[idx]
+            best_b = -1
+            best_rem = capacity + 1

+                r = rem[b]
+                if s <= r and r < best_rem:
+                    best_rem = r
+                    best_b = b
+            if best_b >= 0:

+                loads[worst] -= s
+                rem[worst] += s
+                loads[best_b] += s
+                rem[best_b] -= s
+                if not bins[worst]:
+                    bins.pop(worst)
+                    loads.pop(worst)
+                    rem.pop(worst)
+                    removed = True
+                    improved = True
+                    break
+
+        if removed:
+            continue
+
+        # Try 1-1 swaps: an item from the worst bin swaps with an item in another bin,
+        # freeing enough space in the worst bin to move another item out.
+        for idx in items:
